title: Askatasuna supporters march in Turin to mark 30th anniversary

tea.why: Supporters of the Askatasuna social centre gathered to celebrate its 30th anniversary and protest the December 2025 eviction of its premises.
tea.want: The reopening of the social centre at its former location and an end to police presence in the Vanchiglia neighbourhood.
tea.changed: Nov 22: Police identified approximately ten participants following clashes involving fireworks and tear gas.

summary: On November 22, 2026, supporters of the Askatasuna social centre held a commemorative event in Turin's Vanchiglia district to mark the group's 30th anniversary. The event included debates and a concert in Piazza Santa Giulia. Following the performances, hundreds of participants formed a march toward the group's former headquarters on Corso Regina Margherita, which was evicted in December 2025. According to reports, marchers threw fireworks, petards, and bottles at police officers guarding the site. Authorities responded by deploying water cannons and tear gas to disperse the crowd. The situation returned to calm after approximately ten minutes, and the protesters eventually returned to Piazza Santa Giulia. Police have since identified about ten individuals and are reviewing surveillance footage to determine potential legal responsibilities regarding the unauthorised demonstration.
demands: End to police presence in Vanchiglia
response: Police deployed water cannons and tear gas to disperse the marchers. The Fsp-Polizia di Stato union criticised the event for lacking necessary authorisations and for the conduct of the participants.

updates.text: Supporters marched toward the former Askatasuna site, leading to clashes with police using water cannons and tear gas.
Police identified approximately ten participants and began reviewing footage to assess legal responsibilities.
